acceptanceCriteria: Every planned row for an intent whose map failed to prepare is reported with a step and a refusal reason.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 after the 0.8.0 release. Residual from V1-0142 (merged). In script/dogfood-change.sh's `ocm link` phase, rows for an intent whose map failed to prepare are not reported with a row step, so the report does not say those rows were skipped or why.
title: dogfood-change: an intent whose OCM map failed to prepare gets no link-phase row step
